description: Plan: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.57.html (revision 2), ticket 3. Per specialisation, a call is refused when its argument cannot fit any arrow of the spec (disjoint): refused today, stays refused. An argument that genuinely may fit is accepted; fz-sc8.62 guarantees a miss meets the callee's arm of last resort (fz-sc8.61). Externs (no clause tests; fz-xxd.6) and brands (invisible at runtime; brand_rejects_a_bare_inner) keep refusing overlap. Replaces fz-xxd.5's 'overlap is refused' for plain functions and its any-only narrowing. Motivating probe: Keyword.update([a: 1, s: "x"], :a, 1, fn v -> v + 1 end) is refused with spec/violation (int | binary, int); Elixir returns [a: 2, s: "x"]. OptionParser's :count needs it. Removes the subset gate in match_arrow (types/arrow_match.rs ~354), arrow_set_covers' special case if it only serves that gate, two overlap-refusal unit pins (restated), and specs.md 70-83.
title: A spec refuses a call only when it is proven to fail
